--- title: "A Band of Biometricians" --- ::: {.cell} ::: ### A Band of Biometricians #1 *September 15, 2025*
Watch on YouTube
Listen on Spotify
Welcome to A Band of Biometricians, a professional forestry podcast where we explore the latest topics in forest biometrics, inventory, and growth & yield. In this first episode, I am joined by Dr. John Paul McTague and Dr. Corey Green to discuss the 2025 joint NEMO and SOMENS conference and to dive deep into the topic of Small Area Estimation --- All episodes are also available on our [YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@TheForestersForecast-wb3jl) and [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/4fzgYVHRlYACdPJiM93L3C).
